dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Cash came into the care center through the police after a bite in the prior home. On arrival a police officer mentioned that Cash was on a walk and picked something up off the ground and the kid went to grab it, that is when Cash bit the kid's finger. In the care center, Cash is observed fixating on traffic cones, frequently grabbing and holding onto them and proving difficult to redirect. During walks, she often carries a tennis ball in her mouth and displays leash pulling toward novel dogs. Cash readily allows handlers to pet her and is very social and affiliative with staff and handlers. Cash is available for rescue through one of our new hope partners.
dog.name: Cash
